note: Commissioning directions for twelve distinct new culture kits. This is not source-generation evidence, playable registration, candidate approval or completed animation. Read FACTION_BIBLE and actual factionFrameContract. Each of18roles needs an independent original, native/4x/in-game inspection. All share Theandril muted materials, soft upper-left light, strategic southeast view, realtransparent background, complete padded silhouettes and native pixel density.

designs.name: Cistern Assembly
designs.materials: Limewashed limestone, muted turquoise cloth, rust-red cords, dark glazed jars. Broad lidded-vessel shields, practical wrapped shade hoods and jar-shaped bronze closures. Squat cistern rings, thick shade galleries, low parapets and roofed well courts; not a desert palace. A three-notch water measure cut into a broad vessel silhouette.
designs.people: Mostly human well keepers, gardeners and caravan families; adult practical proportions, varied faces.
designs.heraldry: Three-notch water measure inside one broad lidded vessel.

designs.name: Unsealed Companies
designs.materials: Faded vermilion, undyed canvas, pewter and reused dark plate. Asymmetrical repaired armor panels, broad roll cases and split-bottom standards. Wagon-court settlements with repair yards, canvas canopies, squared portable palisades and occupied store halls; not Sable tents or Cinderforts.
designs.people: Human veterans and civilian repair households; plain work gear with practiced military discipline.
designs.heraldry: A broken wax seal with an unmistakable open lower gap and a short horizontal tie.

designs.name: Lantern Hospices
designs.materials: Beeswax yellow, washed blue, soot-black lantern cages, plain linen. Hooded service coats, broad shields, shielded lamps not glowing magical haloes. Open hospice courtyards with wide ventilated slate roofs, covered galleries, clean cisterns and small enclosed lamp niches.
designs.people: Human care-house attendants and paid escorts; adultsturdyclothlayers, no religious caricatures.
designs.heraldry: A small hooded lamp framed by two protective shutters.

designs.name: Cairnwing Concord
designs.materials: Tawny feathers, oxblood cord, oxidized copper, pale scree. Narrow harnesses, folded feathered forearms, ribbed narrow shields, ledge tools. Bracketed low stone halls, terraced load courts and wind-braced lift housings integrated into freestanding settlement silhouette; no giant scenery rock or inaccessible floating castle.
designs.people: Tool-using feathered cairnfolk with short avian beaks, two legs and two dexterous arms with folded forearm feather fans; human port households. No spread wings, flying poses or implied flight.
designs.heraldry: A single stepped feather with three unequal notches.

designs.name: Red Sluice Directorate
designs.materials: Brick red, dull celadon cloth, tarred oak, black chain and weathered bronze. Broad rectangular rain shields, hooded crew coats, horizontal bar motifs. Low sluice-gate inspired maintenance halls, wheel-braced gantries, thick brick channelside courtyards; no surrounding waterrectangle or actualtile.
designs.people: Human waterworks crew households and disciplined municipal escorts.
designs.heraldry: A barred spillway with three broad vertical openings and one horizontal lifting bar.

designs.name: Velvet Meridian
designs.materials: Madder red, smoke silver, blue-black woven cloth. Weighted long hems, small calibrated discs, half-round shields and layered soft scholar coats. Low round slate observatories, cloth-measure galleries, concentric open courtyards and dark-curtained study halls; no glowingastralwizardtowers.
designs.people: Human weavers, night navigators and school households; practical escorts and scholars.
designs.heraldry: A plumb line crossing three unequal stitches.

designs.name: Brine Choir
designs.materials: Coral clay, pale eelgrass, wet slate, matte shell inlay. Broad fin-fold collars, low crescent shields and practical woven salt-cloaks. Paired pool courts, perforated wind walls and low rounded sheltered buildings; not Reedbound stilts or Glassglasspalaces.
designs.people: Brinefolk humanoids with matte blue-grey skin, small folded neck fins and visible humanlike tool-hands; human shore households. No fish-tail bodies, no underwaterposes or magical bubbles.
designs.heraldry: A broken concentric ripple: two unequal open rings, not a keel or sail.

designs.name: Emberwake Convocation
designs.materials: Ash white, smoked orange, muted sulfur green. Ceramic face screens, seed jars, padded kiln aprons and short heat-resistant wraps. Low firebreak compounds, split-vent clay kilns, seed stores and broad ceramic roofs; no burning scenery or lava, distinct from Cindermilitarywalls.
designs.people: Human seedkeepers, kiln workers and survivor escorts; practical masked workers, not fireelementals.
designs.heraldry: A half-blackened seed wheel enclosing a single pale seed.

designs.name: Underhush Exchange
designs.materials: Clay brown, pewter, pale lime, tiny amber route markers. Rounded work shields, tactile tally beads, padded low helmets, broadhandedcompactworkgear. Low keyhole arches, nested vent stacks and squat dwelling halls with generous horizontal shapes; not Covenant squarebuttresses or Morrowlivingroofs.
designs.people: Broad-handed short burrowfolk with compact furred bodies, small rounded ears, blunt faces and visible dexterous fingers; human surface traders. No dwarfbeard stereotype or exposedrodentteeth.
designs.heraldry: A keyhole passage nested inside two low open arches.

designs.name: Vesper Court
designs.materials: Muted garnet, tarnished silver, charcoal velvet and restrained cool ivory. High folded collars, narrow ribbed cuirasses, long split court coats, covered carriage shapes. Shuttered vineyard manor houses, enclosed slate courts, tall narrow chimneys and covered walks; not skeletal terraces or copiedgothiccastles. Ships with dark enclosed cabins and silver-edged stern galleries while maintaining hullrole silhouettes.
designs.people: Living adult human retainers and artisans; marshals may be pale vampiric patrons with subtle severe features. No fanged grinning caricature, batwings, skullarmy or glowingeyes.
designs.heraldry: An open silver vessel beneath two unequal dusk bars, one small garnet bead.

designs.name: Manytrack Moot
designs.materials: Bark black, pale tawny hide, moss blue, stitched raw linen. Crossed path cords, broad clearance arch motifs and wood/hide shields. Open gathering rings, broad low communal halls, varied-height doors and maintained route gates; not an untamed beastcamp.
designs.people: Several political humanoid lineages with ordinary tool-hands: guard/spearman deerlike short swept horns; scout/surveyor foxlike furred ears and tail; heavy/marshal broad boarlike blunt faces without exaggerated tusks; human engineer/colonist. Cavalry hornedhumanoid rider on ordinaryhorse. No quadrupedal feral troops or petpeople.
designs.heraldry: A fork joining three unlike broad tracks.

designs.name: Margin Observance
designs.materials: Parchment grey, dull cinnabar, matte ink black, weathered lead. Narrow document cases, interrupted stripe patterns, practical slate shoulder covers and pale-edged shields. Slab-roof archive stations, protected empty wall recesses and enclosed supply yards; no levitatingglyphs or blackwizardcliche.
designs.people: Human copyists, custodians and supplyhouseholds; work-conscious guardedcamp equipment.
designs.heraldry: One broken bracket with a deliberate open corner and small offset registration bar.
